services.name: Waikiki Group Snorkel Adventure
services.desc: Looking to get out on the water but don’t need a full private boat? Our Join a Group Snorkel Cruise is designed for travelers who want the Tradewind Charters experience at a per-person rate. Departing from Honolulu’s south shore, just minutes from Waikiki, you’ll join other guests on an afternoon ride along the coastline before mooring at one of our favorite snorkel spots with clear water and abundant marine life. Relax on deck as we cruise toward Diamond Head, then slip into the water to look for Hawaiian green sea turtles, reef fish, and other local marine life.
